scope: Historical astronomy composition only; not current candidate or motion acceptance

reviewer.method: Both reviewers actually viewed the adopted JPG and historical DevTools PNG and checked current adoption scope; independent reviewer received source inputs rather than author conclusions. Coarse composition only: reference encodes 390x843, runtime PNG encodes 192x413 despite logical viewport 390x844/DPR3 metadata. Different dates/data and native system chrome are excluded. No present-candidate, pixel-fidelity or motion inference.

observations.claim: Historical astronomy composition preserves the adopted separation between the date/ruler, moon and weather modules.
observations.observed: The reference uses distinct full-width white rounded modules, including a pale inner moon-data area. The historical runtime date/ruler area reads as a continuous gray field with materially weaker module boundaries and inner/outer hierarchy. Independent review agrees. Exact colors, radii and typography cannot be judged from the downscaled runtime PNG.
observations.next_action: For the separately scoped product repair, capture the current candidate at the corresponding astronomy scroll position and logical viewport without downscaling. Inspect the shared card/date-ruler owners, repair confirmed hierarchy deviations and compare again before propagating that implementation. This historical finding is not proof of current candidate state.

observations.claim: Panel handle behavior, action hit regions, cancellation and animation conform on the current target device.

Button order and color families are visible, but neither hit regions nor motion/results can be established.
